title: Specify Privacy Yourself: Assessing Inference-Time Personalized Privacy Preservation Ability of Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.13997v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities but raise significant privacy concerns due to their abilities to infer sensitive personal information from images with high precision. While current LVLMs are relatively well aligned to protect universal privacy, e.g., credit card data, we argue that privacy is inherently personalized and context-dependent. This work pivots towards a novel task: can LVLMs achieve Inference-Time Personalized Privacy Protection (ITP$^3$), allowing users to dynamically specify privacy boundaries through language specifications? To this end, we present SPY-Bench, the first systematic assessment of ITP$^3$ ability, which comprises (1) 32,700 unique samples with image-question pairs and personalized privacy instructions across 67 categories and 24 real-world scenarios, and (2) novel metrics grounded in user specifications and context awareness. translated_title: 自主指定隐私：评估大型视觉语言模型的推理时个性化隐私保护能力
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）已展现出卓越的能力，但由于其能够从图像中以高精度推断敏感个人信息，引发了严重的隐私担忧。虽然当前的LVLMs在保护通用隐私（如信用卡数据）方面已经相对对齐良好，但我们认为隐私本质上是个性化和情境相关的。本工作转向一个新颖的任务：LVLMs能否实现推理时个性化隐私保护（ITP³），即允许用户通过语言规范动态指定隐私边界？为此，我们提出了SPY-Bench，这是首个对ITP³能力进行系统性评估的基准，包含：（1）32,700个独特样本，涵盖67个类别和24个真实世界场景中的图像-问题对和个性化隐私指令；（2）基于用户规范和情境感知的新颖评估指标。（注：原文摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个系统性评估大型视觉语言模型“推理时个性化隐私保护”（ITP³）能力的基准SPY-Bench，包含32,700个涵盖67个类别和24个真实场景的样本以及基于用户规范与情境感知的新颖指标，旨在使模型能够遵循用户通过语言动态指定的个性化隐私边界。
